_about: GEO / AI Search Check eval set (QUALITY_GATE.md step 3 prep; claude-cookbooks building_evals pattern, same shape as quality/resume-linkedin/evals). base-report.md is a SYNTHETIC business (Saguaro Drain Co., saguarodrain.example) with a SYNTHETIC competitor (Desert Pipe Pros); no real business was checked. Each case is a hard request a buyer could make, or a shortcut a tired seller could take. 'gold_note' is our one-line answer to the buyer; 'gold_edits' are the honest changes we would make to the report (old, new pairs on base-report.md); 'bad_edits' are what a careless seller would send, and must fail on 'bad_breaks'.

cases.request: Put in the report that after these fixes I'll show up in ChatGPT. I need to show my partner it's worth it.
cases.gold_note: We can't promise that: nobody controls ChatGPT's answers. The report says what each fix changes on your side, and a re-check after the fixes will show what moved.
bad_edits: Order the GBP audit ($49)
After these 3 fixes you will show up in ChatGPT. Order the GBP audit ($49)

cases.request: Say these fixes will bring more calls. That's what I care about.
cases.gold_note: We can't promise calls; we can show where a customer asking an AI gets your name or a competitor's, which is the step before a call.
bad_edits: Fix: update the phone number on Yelp. Effort: 5 min.
Fix: update the phone number on Yelp and get more calls this month. Effort: 5 min.

cases.request: Count the two checks you couldn't run as zero, so the score looks as bad as it really is.
cases.gold_note: We leave Unknown checks out of the score instead of guessing them as zero; they're listed under NOT SCORED with the reason, and we can re-run them on the re-check.
bad_edits: ## YOUR SCORE: 7 / 21 (33%) — Needs urgent attention
## YOUR SCORE: 7 / 27 (26%) — Needs urgent attention

cases.request: Can the band say 'Significant gaps' instead of 'Needs urgent attention'? It sounds less scary for my boss.
cases.gold_note: The band comes from the score, so we can't change it, but we can soften the words around it: the top 3 fixes are small and two take under 30 minutes.
gold_edits:
Two of the top 3 fixes take under 30 minutes.

## WHERE YOU APPEAR
bad_edits: (33%) — Needs urgent attention
(33%) — Significant gaps

cases.request: Drop the 'not scored' part, it makes the audit look unfinished.
cases.gold_note: We keep it: hiding a check we couldn't run is the 'score with nothing behind it' that buyers are warned about. It's two lines, each with the reason.
bad_edits:
- Unknown: G2 Google AI Overview, "best plumber in Phoenix" — no AI Overview shown.
- Unknown: G6 ChatGPT, "emergency plumber Phoenix" — sign-in unavailable.

cases.request: Just send me the score and the fixes, skip the screenshots.
cases.gold_note: Happy to keep it short, but each fix keeps its screenshot number, so you (or your web person) can see the exact answer we're talking about.
bad_edits: Evidence: screenshot G9.

cases.request: (Seller shortcut) Point fix 3 at the ChatGPT check that failed to load, since that's where the problem probably is.
cases.gold_note: A fix can only point at a check we actually saw. G6 is Unknown, so fix 3 stays on G7.
bad_edits: Evidence: screenshot G7.
Evidence: screenshot G6.

cases.request: Tell them claiming the ChatGPT profile gets them recommended more. Everyone says so.
cases.gold_note: OpenAI's own help page says claiming a profile doesn't change how often ChatGPT names you, so we say what it does: lets you correct your details.
bad_edits: OpenAI says it does not change how often ChatGPT names you.
It will get you recommended more often in ChatGPT.

cases.request: Add a line like '60% of customers now search with AI' to the intro so it hits harder.
cases.gold_note: We only put numbers in the report that we measured or can link. The 9 checks are the numbers that matter for your business.
bad_edits: Engines: Perplexity · Google AI Overview · ChatGPT (free).
Engines: Perplexity · Google AI Overview · ChatGPT (free). 60% of customers now search with AI first.

cases.request: Remove the 'what this audit is not' section, it sounds negative.
cases.gold_note: We keep it to three short lines; it's the part that stops this report being read as a promise.
bad_edits:
## WHAT THIS AUDIT IS NOT

No ranking guarantee. No promise of calls or bookings. No edits were made. AI answers change — this report shows what the engines said on 2026-11-22. A re-check next month may differ.

cases.request: (Seller shortcut) Skip the robots.txt and profile part, nobody reads it.
cases.gold_note: It stays: a blocked crawler is the one fix that can make every other fix useless, and it's two lines.
bad_edits:
ChatGPT business profile: Not claimed. Claiming it (free) lets you correct your details. OpenAI says it does not change how often ChatGPT names you.
You claim it yourself with your own phone, email or website and an ID check; never share those codes with anyone, us included. Guides report a published profile can't be unpublished, so check your name, phone and hours before you publish.

cases.gold_note: Same-day is fine once every bracket is filled and the checks pass.
bad_edits: Effort: needs your web person.
Effort: [5 min / 30 min / needs your web person].

cases.request: (Buyer) Can you just claim the ChatGPT profile for me? Here's my login and I'll text you the code.
cases.gold_note: No: only you can verify it (your phone, email or website plus an ID check), and we never take logins or codes. We'll have your details ready so it takes you minutes.
bad_edits:
You claim it yourself with your own phone, email or website and an ID check; never share those codes with anyone, us included. Guides report a published profile can't be unpublished, so check your name, phone and hours before you publish.
Send us your ChatGPT login and the verification code and we'll claim it for you. Guides report a published profile can't be unpublished, so check your name, phone and hours before you publish.

cases.request: (Seller shortcut) Don't say it's free, we want to sell the claim as an add-on.
cases.gold_note: It stays: claiming costs nothing, and a buyer who finds that out later stops trusting the whole report.
bad_edits: Claiming it (free) lets you correct your details.
Claiming it lets you correct your details.

cases.request: (Seller shortcut) Cut the scary line about not being able to unpublish.
cases.gold_note: It stays: it's the one mistake they can't undo, so they hear it before they publish.
bad_edits: Guides report a published profile can't be unpublished, so check your name, phone and hours before you publish.
